_: A BLANK LEFT IN A DRAFT (the owner, 2026-10-30): a draft can hold a slot like [REASON] or [DATE] for the owner to fill, and Send went out with it. Send refuses while one remains - the server (taskuary/blanks.py, read by verdicts) and the draft box (website/src/blanks.js), which reads this same file. A slot is a bracket that is ALL CAPS (two letters or more), a run of underscores, or a short phrase that starts with a template cue. `not_slots` are the bracketed words real mail carries (a gateway's [EXTERNAL], a log's [ERROR]); a bracket holding a `said` word is an editor's own note ([name withheld]), never a slot.
